DELHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY Petitioner(
 VERSUS  KRISHEN K. SETH & ORS. Respondent(
 (IA No. 99368/2022 - CONDONATION OF DELAY IN FILING  IA No. 99369/2022 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.
 IA No. 99365/2022 - RECALLING THE COURTS ORDER)
 Date : 10-07-2023
This matter was called on for hearing today.

CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HRISHIKESH ROY  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PANKAJ MITHAL  For Petitioner(s) Mr. Sanjiv Sen, Sr. Adv.
 Ms. Manika Tripathy, AOR  Mr. Ashutosh Kaushik, Adv.
 Mr. Mridul Suri, Adv.
 For Respondent(s) Mr. Lzafeer Ahmad B. F., AOR  Mr. Ashim Sood, Adv.
 Mr. Dhruv Sood, Adv.
 Mr. Kuber Bajaj, Adv.
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R This Court passed the final order on 28.04.2016 declaring that the land acquisition proceedings have lapsed under Section 24(2) of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

Thereafter, the Constitution Bench of this Court in Indore Development Authority v. Manoharlal & Ors. reported in (2020) 8 SCC 129 gave a different interpretation to the provisions of Section 24 of the 2013 Act.

1 judgment, the Delhi Development Authority has filed this application for recall of the earlier order.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioner has produced orders of this Court in similarly disposed of matters where notice was issued on the miscellaneous applications on 20.02.2023 and 28.02.2023 respectively.
Issue notice on the application for condonation of delay as also on the Miscellaneous Application for recalling the Courts order.
Mr. Lzafeer Ahmad, learned counsel accepts notice for the respondent-land owner(s).
Notice on the other respondents be served.
Counter affidavit, if any, be filed within four weeks.
Rejoinder affidavit, if any, be filed within four weeks thereafter.

(NITIN TALREJA) (KAMLESH RAWAT)
